## Type of Change

- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix (PATCH release)
- [ ] `feat`: New feature / tool capability (MINOR release)
- [ ] `BREAKING CHANGE`: Incompatible API change (MAJOR release)
- [ ] `docs` / `chore` / `refactor`: Maintenance with no version bump

## Quality & Security Checklist

- [ ] Local commits are GPG signed (`git commit -S`).
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://conventionalcommits.org) formatting.
- [ ] Unit tests pass locally (`pnpm run test`).
- [ ] Code formatting and linting pass locally (`pnpm run lint`).
- [ ] Type definitions build cleanly (`pnpm run build:stdio`).
